g.text: Effect of a pre-entry strain offset during visual occlusion
Each horizontal segment pairs two independent flights with the same seed, controller and 4 s shutter.
Rows follow seeds 26112131, 26112137, 26112143. Vision and oracle pairs indicate repeat-flight variation.
Axis RMSE spans 49–55 s. Task completion uses the registered joint 1 s dwell.
